plain: A person who lives in an area and is represented by an elected official

webster.text: Setting; constituting; applied to parts of a thing that are essential to it.

more.text: That which constitutes or composes, as a part, or an essential part.
One who appoints or elects another to an office or employment.

example.quote: This is the case with all numerous representative legislatures, the members of which are frequently elected, and constantly within the view of their constituents.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter XI, Jan. 10, 1788
